runtime_policy.intake_phase_keys: Map approved proposals to existing variant_catalog keys before Web/Quest intake.

concepts.name: Royal Insect Guardian
concepts.notes: Use compound-eye helmet, emerald V chest core, wing-like dorsal shell, and agile white base suit.

concepts.name: Rescue Knight Sleek
concepts.notes: Protective but not bulky. Curved chest plate, shoulder lips, compact spine, cyan visor.

concepts.name: Memory Ninja Light
concepts.notes: Quiet sharp silhouette. Thin seams, low shoulders, integrated scarf-like back panel.

concepts.name: Dragon Scale Rescuer
concepts.notes: Swept horn visor and scale-like armor should remain tokusatsu clean, not fantasy medieval.

concepts.name: Cyber Oath Runner
concepts.notes: Use asymmetric details only where intentional. Keep left/right runtime pairing compatible.

concepts.name: Orbital Citizen Guardian
concepts.notes: Astronaut influence is allowed, but the visor and chest core must remain sharp hero language.

concepts.name: Flame Oath Form
concepts.notes: Mechanical flame V, orange spine vents, controlled shoulder flares.

concepts.name: Water Stream Form
concepts.notes: Smooth flow lines, back fin kept close to the body, narrow elegant silhouette.

concepts.name: Lightning Vector Form
concepts.notes: Sharp zigzags must be organized panel language, not random crack noise.

concepts.name: Beast Guardian
concepts.notes: Heroic beast form, not monster. Claw accents should be clean and wearable.

concepts.name: Avian Flight Form
concepts.notes: Mechanical feather fins, close-to-body back plates, narrow waist.

concepts.name: Ancient Relic Oath
concepts.notes: Modern tokusatsu relic finish. Avoid stone-statue heaviness.

concepts.name: Medical Rescue Hero
concepts.notes: Public service clarity, high-visibility lines, abstract rescue cross core.

concepts.name: Prototype Shadow Hero
concepts.notes: Prototype asymmetry can be explored, but record intentional asymmetry in sidecar.

concepts.name: Final Oath Form
concepts.notes: Majestic final-form silhouette, expanded but still sleek, with organized full-body glow flow.
